note: Every dimension scores at its worst tier: di=1 (not_systematic triggers the DI floor), gov=1 (none_manual is scoreGovernance's default/lowest case), tooling=1 (no crm or reporting tool in q14), dc=1 (not_from_data is scoreDecisionCulture's default), tc=1 (low_comfort+case_by_case matches scoreTeamCapacity's explicit ===1 branch). points=2*1+2*1+1+1+1=7 -> bandFromPoints(7)<12 -> Foundational. di=1 is already Foundational so the Established-only override never fires (overrideApplied=false). Both di=1 and gov=1 push flaggedDimensions to length 2 -> remediationOnly=true. Spec step 5: two flags (DI and Governance both Foundational) -> remediationOnly=true. Cross-check: Foundational but bucket 'Data Infrastructure', not 'ML / Predictive' -> no flag.

Every dimension lands in its middle tier: di=2 (partial/some_share/mixed don't hit either the all-1 floor conditions or the all-3 ceiling conditions, so scoreDataInfrastructure falls through to its `return 2` default), gov=2 (semi_automated), tooling=2 (exactly one of crm/reporting present), dc=2 (leadership_managers), tc=2 (some_adhoc+requires_approval matches neither the ===1 nor ===3 explicit branch, falls to default 2). points=2*2+2*2+2+2+2=14 -> bandFromPoints(14) is >=12 and <17 -> Developing. No dimension is 1, so flaggedDimensions is empty and overrideApplied is false (override only applies when compositeLevel would be Established). Spec step 5: zero flags -> remediationOnly=false. Cross-check needs Foundational; Developing -> no flag.

Every dimension hits its explicit ===3 branch: di=3 (most_share_auto+very_confident+very_familiar all together), gov=3 (mostly_automated), tooling=3 (both crm_case_tool and reporting_analytics present), dc=3 (anyone_with_access), tc=3 (dedicated_staff+fast). points=2*3+2*3+3+3+3=21 (the rubric max) -> Established. di=3 (not 1) so the override never fires; no flags. No flags -> remediationOnly=false; Established -> no cross-check.

Only q4_collection_scope is dropped to 'not_systematic' (which alone forces di=1 via scoreDataInfrastructure's first OR-branch, even though q6/q8 are both at their top tier) — every other dimension is maxed: gov=3, tooling=3, dc=3, tc=3. Pre-override points=2*1+2*3+3+3+3=17 -> bandFromPoints(17)>=17 -> would-be Established. Step 3's override then fires because di_score===1 && compositeLevel==='Established' -> forces compositeLevel down to Developing and sets overrideApplied=true. di=1 also pushes flaggedDimensions=['data_infrastructure'] (gov=3 so governance is not flagged). This is the 'can't run a project on data that doesn't exist' rule even when every other dimension is excellent. Spec step 5: one flag runs alongside a deliverable -> remediationOnly=false. Cross-check (Rules: compositeLevel==='Foundational' && bucket ML / Predictive) is evaluated on the post-override level, Developing, so the ML bucket does NOT raise it -- the override caps down to Developing, never to Foundational.

di=1 (not_systematic/own_island/not_confident all trip the floor), gov=2 (semi_automated), tooling=1 (only spreadsheets, no crm or reporting tool), dc=2 (leadership_managers), tc=2 (some_adhoc+requires_approval, the default-2 fallthrough). points=2*1+2*2+1+2+2=11 -> bandFromPoints(11)<12 -> Foundational. di=1 already Foundational so override never fires; gov=2 (not 1) keeps flaggedDimensions to just ['data_infrastructure']. compositeLevel==='Foundational' && scoutBucket==='ML / Predictive' triggers crossCheckFlag -- distinct from the override fixture's Established-band ML case. One flag (DI) -> remediationOnly=false. Foundational + 'ML / Predictive' -> spec cross-check fires (crossCheckFlag non-null).

di=1 (not_systematic/own_island/not_confident), gov=1 (none_manual is the default/lowest branch), tooling=3 (both crm_case_tool and reporting_analytics present), dc=3 (anyone_with_access), tc=3 (dedicated_staff+fast). points=2*1+2*1+3+3+3=13 -> bandFromPoints(13)>=12 -> Developing (not Foundational, unlike the first fixture case which also has both flags but a lower band). di=1 is not Established so no override; both di=1 and gov=1 -> flaggedDimensions has both entries, giving remediationOnly=true at a non-Foundational band -- the point of this fixture is to prove remediationOnly is driven by flag count, not by compositeLevel. Spec Rules: remediationOnly is flaggedDimensions.length >= 2, independent of band -> true at Developing. Developing -> no cross-check.

Spec rubric: DI=2 (no Foundational trigger -- Q4 partial, Q6 some share, Q8 mixed -- and Q6 is not 'most share automatically', so not Established); Gov=1 (Q13 not automated); Tooling=1 (spreadsheets only: no CRM, no reporting tool); DC=2 (Q11 leadership/managers); TC=2 (neither low+case-by-case nor dedicated+fast). Step 2: 2*2+2*1+1+2+2=11, the top of the 7-11 band -> Foundational. Step 3: DI is not Foundational -> no override. Step 4: Gov Foundational -> flag governance. Step 5: one flag -> not remediation-only. Not ML / Predictive -> no cross-check. Upper band edge, paired with band-edge-12-developing.

Identical to band-edge-11-foundational except Q14 adds a CRM -> Tooling=2 (has one of CRM/reporting). Step 2: 2*2+2*1+2+2+2=12, the bottom of the 12-16 band -> Developing. One point moves the band. Gov=1 -> flag governance; one flag -> not remediation-only; not Foundational -> no cross-check.

DI=3 (Q6 most share automatically + Q8 very confident + Q7 very familiar); Gov=2 (Q13 semi-automated); Tooling=2 (reporting tool without CRM -- the spec's documented either-direction extension, Rules last bullet); DC=2; TC=2 (Q16 fast but Q15 is ad hoc, not dedicated staff -- Established needs both). Step 2: 2*3+2*2+2+2+2=16, top of 12-16 -> Developing. No Foundational DI/Gov -> no flags, no override, no remediation, no cross-check.

DI=3, Gov=3 (Q13 mostly automated), Tooling=2 (CRM only), DC=1 (Q11 not empowerment-based), TC=2. Step 2: 2*3+2*3+2+1+2=17, the bottom of 17-21 -> Established. Step 4: only DI and Governance produce mandatory flags, so a Foundational Decision Culture is NOT flagged -> flaggedDimensions empty. No override (DI=3), not remediation-only, not Foundational -> no cross-check.

DI=1 because Q8 'not confident' alone is a Foundational trigger (the rubric's three triggers are OR'd), even with Q4 systematic and Q6 most share automatically. Every other dimension at 3. Step 2: 2*1+2*3+3+3+3=17 -> Established before the override. Step 3: Foundational DI caps the composite at Developing -> overrideApplied=true. Step 4: flag data_infrastructure. Step 5: one flag -> not remediation-only. Post-override level is Developing -> no cross-check. 17 is also the maximum points any DI=1 org can reach, so the override can only ever fire at exactly 17.

DI=1 (Q6 'own island'), Gov=3, Tooling=3, DC=3, TC=2. Step 2: 2*1+2*3+3+3+2=16 -> already Developing. Step 3 caps the composite at Developing; it is already there, so nothing is capped -> overrideApplied=false (spec Test contract: override is true when points >= 17 but DI=1). The flag is independent of the override (step 4) -> data_infrastructure flagged. One flag -> not remediation-only; no cross-check.

Tooling edge (spec Test contract: neither tool -> Foundational): four tools selected but none is a CRM or a reporting tool -> Tooling=1. Tool count is irrelevant; only CRM/reporting count. DI=2, Gov=2, DC=2, TC=2. Step 2: 2*2+2*2+1+2+2=13 -> Developing. Tooling is not a flagged dimension -> no flags; no remediation; no cross-check.

Tooling edge (spec Test contract: reporting-tool-without-CRM -> Developing, the code-documented extension). Tooling=2. DI=2, Gov=1, DC=2, TC=2. Step 2: 2*2+2*1+2+2+2=12 -> Developing. This case is built so the extension is load-bearing: under the original rubric (Developing only for CRM-without-reporting) Tooling would be 1, points 11, Foundational, and the ML / Predictive bucket would raise the cross-check. Per the current spec: Developing, flag governance, one flag -> not remediation-only, not Foundational -> no cross-check.

Tooling edge (spec Test contract: both tools -> Established): CRM + reporting tool present, spreadsheets alongside them change nothing -> Tooling=3. DI=2, Gov=2, DC=2, TC=2. Step 2: 2*2+2*2+3+2+2=15 -> Developing. No flags, no override, no remediation, no cross-check.

DI=2, Gov=2, Tooling=1 (no tools at all), DC=1 (Q11 not empowerment-based), TC=1 (Q15 low comfort + Q16 case-by-case). Step 2: 2*2+2*2+1+1+1=11 -> Foundational. Neither DI nor Governance is Foundational, so the band is Foundational with ZERO mandatory flags -> flaggedDimensions empty, not remediation-only. Foundational + ML / Predictive -> cross-check fires. Shows the cross-check keys on the composite level, not on the flags.

Team Capacity edge: Foundational needs BOTH Q15 low comfort AND Q16 case-by-case; Established needs BOTH dedicated staff AND fast. Low comfort + fast matches neither -> 'anything else' -> TC=2. All others at 3. Step 2: 2*3+2*3+3+3+2=20 -> Established. No flags, no override, no remediation, no cross-check.

TC=1 (low comfort + case-by-case, the rubric's Foundational pair). All others at 3. Step 2: 2*3+2*3+3+3+1=19 -> Established. Team Capacity is not a flagged dimension and has no override (step 3 is DI-only, step 4 DI/Governance only) -> no flags, no remediation, no cross-check.

DI edge: the rubric's Established cell names only Q6 most share automatically + Q8 very confident + Q7 very familiar; Q4 is a Foundational trigger only when 'not systematic'. Q4 'partial' therefore does not block Established -> DI=3. Gov=2, Tooling=2, DC=2, TC=2. Step 2: 2*3+2*2+2+2+2=16 -> Developing. No flags.

DI edge: Q6 and Q8 at their top but Q7 only 'somewhat familiar' -> the Established cell needs all three -> 'anything else' -> DI=2. All others at 3. Step 2: 2*2+2*3+3+3+3=19 -> Established. DI=2 is not Foundational -> no override, no flag; no remediation, no cross-check.

Spec validated profile 1 (paper-based org: Foundational on both DI and Governance -> remediation-only, both flags mandatory). DI=1 (all three triggers), Gov=1 (Q13 not automated), Tooling=1 (spreadsheets only), DC=2, TC=2. Step 2: 2+2+1+2+2=9 -> Foundational. Step 3: not Established -> no override. Step 4: both flags. Step 5: 2 flags -> remediation-only. Bucket Data Infrastructure -> no cross-check.

Spec validated profile 2 (mixed-maturity org: Governance-only flag -> named workstream runs alongside the deliverable). DI=2, Gov=1, Tooling=3, DC=3, TC=2. Step 2: 2*2+2*1+3+3+2=14 -> Developing. Step 4: governance flagged; step 5: one flag -> not remediation-only (ship_deliverable with the workstream alongside). No override (DI=2), no cross-check.

Spec validated profile 3 (well-resourced-but-siloed: DI Foundational despite high points -> override, capped at Developing). Q6 'own island' (siloed systems) -> DI=1 despite systematic collection and high confidence; every other dimension 3. Step 2: 2*1+2*3+3+3+3=17 -> Established before step 3, which caps it at Developing -> overrideApplied=true. Flag data_infrastructure; one flag -> not remediation-only; Developing -> no cross-check.

Spec validated profile 4 (dual gaps, strong capacity: both flags -> remediation-only regardless of capacity scores). DI=1 (Q8 not confident), Gov=1, Tooling=3, DC=3, TC=3. Step 2: 2*1+2*1+3+3+3=13 -> Developing. Not Established -> no override. Both flags -> remediation-only. ML / Predictive bucket, but Developing, not Foundational -> no cross-check: strong capacity keeps the band out of Foundational, and remediation-only (not a redirect) is the spec's answer.

Every dimension at 1: points 2+2+1+1+1=7, the rubric minimum -> Foundational. No override (not Established). Both DI and Governance flagged -> remediation-only. Foundational + ML / Predictive -> cross-check also fires: the two signals are independent and can co-occur.
